info.name: Sanad Auth
info.description:
Every current Auth request with success and failure examples.

Use the Sanad Local environment.
Development base URL: https://localhost:7296

Placeholders only. Do not put real JWT keys, SMTP passwords, SMS Misr secrets, or live OTPs in this file.

Saved examples show the HTTP status, body, and `code` the API actually maps. Framework 401/403 (missing token / restricted token) have no Sanad `code`.

National ID back image. jpeg/png/webp, max 5 MB.

request.description: Normal JWT. Multipart fields front and back (both required). Upsert: first call creates Pending; later calls replace both images and return status to Pending. If the user is Active, a replace also sets PendingVerification and revokes every DeviceSession — log in again. First upload on an Active user does not change User status. Responses never include file URLs.

request.description: Normal JWT. Multipart field file. Success 204. Family / Medical / Companion only.
Normal JWT. Streams the private image. 404 Identity.Avatar.NotFound when none uploaded.
Requires Normal JWT. Returns the caller's own profile. accountType is display-only: 1 Family, 2 Medical Caregiver, 3 Companion Caregiver, 4 Elderly.

Requires Normal JWT. Partial update of the caller's arabicFullName, englishFullName, email, and phoneNumber. Omitted fields stay unchanged. Role is never accepted. A changed email/phone becomes unverified and a fresh OTP is sent; complete it with Verify OTP. Submitting the current email/phone is a no-op.
